method: Builds the widest manifestFacts member the stated caps allow (every count Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER; every listed fact a `dependency` with a 512-unit CJK path and 256 lone surrogates in `name` and `group`; every file entry an Unknown `path-not-citable` entry whose census form begins with 512 control characters; every remainder place in that census form; the policy identifier and version 4,096 lone surrogates each) and measures the check record's bytes with and without it, two-space JSON with one trailing newline. argv: recognizers, files listed per new recognizer, facts listed, places listed.

runs.meaning: the five recognizers of version 2.7 at their 250-file cap, no remainder: the widest member before version 2.12

adopted: the five of version 2.7 at 250, the five of version 2.12 at 100, the root plus 250 places
